summary: Frontend-only validation of the institutional refoundation of Kiltikonet.fr (Phases B–H). All 10 refactored routes return 200, all required data-testid selectors are present, the 4 real metrics from /api/observatory/public/now (2 641 / 10 / 18 / 10) render on /, /now, /culture-connect/2026, and the institutional footer, each with its 'src · <collection>' data-lineage caption. The unified InstitutionalFooter with footer-lineage is present on all 10 public pages. The refactored components (CultureConnect*, Rejoindre, ContactKiltikonet, APropos, NowPage, KiltikonetHome, Observatory, Infrastructure) contain zero occurrences of rounded-2xl / shadow-lg / shadow-xl (grep -c = 0 for all 10 files). Newsreader serif (italic monumental headings) and Manrope sans-serif interface fonts render correctly. Dark #0F0C09 institutional background renders on /now with gold discreet accents.

code_review_notes: Refactored component files (10) are clean of rounded-2xl / shadow-lg / shadow-xl (grep verified).

HTML page dumps still contain 'rounded-2xl' 2x and (on /culture-connect) 'shadow-lg' 4x — these originate from shared legacy components (main header/CookieBanner/user-menu), NOT from the refactored pages. Spec explicitly allows this ('Les autres composants du repo peuvent conserver ces classes'). No action required, but if the institutional aesthetic must be enforced site-wide, the main header component still uses SaaS-style rounded elements on light beige background — visually inconsistent with the dark #0F0C09 institutional palette of /now.

Console noise (unrelated to refonte): 'THREE.THREE.Clock has been deprecated' warning and 'Multiple instances of Three.js being imported' warning appear on every navigation (from Splash/3D scene). Several 422 responses to a backend probe are logged on route changes — worth investigating but does not affect any tested feature.

Data lineage caption is rendered as uppercase 'SRC · OBSERVATORY/PUBLIC/NOW' on home Section 07 and lowercase 'src · db.analytics_events (canonical)' on /now — both variants are consistent with the tokens/atoms design; acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None. Only public read-only endpoint /api/observatory/public/now was exercised.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Institutional refoundation is fully verified. Refactored routes: /, /a-propos, /now, /culture-connect, /culture-connect/2026, /culture-connect/2027, /rejoindre, /contact, /observatory, /infrastructure. All required data-testid selectors: apropos-page, now-page, now-metric-{events|registrations|workspace|identities}, cc2026-metric-{events|registrations|workspace|identities}, join-{artist|pro|institution|partner}, contact-{email|location|instagram|linkedin}, metric-events, institutional-footer, footer-lineage. Real metrics values as of test: 2641 events (fr-FR formatted as '2\u202f641'), 10 registrations, 18 workspace, 10 identities. NOTE for future tests: because of French locale formatting, do NOT string-match raw '2641' — the DOM contains '2\u202f641' (narrow no-break space). Splash 'NOU.' + cookie banner still appear on entry; dismiss with 'Passer' + 'Accepter'. Header is hidden on /now, /maintenant, /observatory (hideHeaderRoutes).
